title: Deep in the Forest by Bodarevsky
content: Deep in the ForestbyNicholai Kornilovich Bodarevsky(1850-1921)A little girl is lost in the forest while gathering mushrooms. The painting is byNicholai Kornilovich Bodarevsky(1850-1921), a Ukranian painter of historical scenes, nudes, and portraits.-----See more works by him atWikimedia Commons.Nicholai Kornilovich Bodarevskyon Wikipedia.
